lines.en: label utadorm40p2:
scene clearnightsky
Apparently, what I meant earlier by “I can do anything I want” is “I can stand around and feel awkward while waiting for one of the room’s two tiny inhabitants to return.”
lines.zh: 看来我之前说的“我想做什么就做什么”，实际意思是“我可以站在这儿尴尬地等着这间屋子的两个小住户之一回来”。

lines.en: As you may be able to tell by another contemplative walk home, neither one of them ever showed up. So now, there’s nothing left to do but put an end to this night the only way I know how.
lines.zh: 从我又一次沉思着走回家这点你大概能猜到，她们俩谁都没出现。所以现在，除了用我唯一知道的方式结束这一晚之外，已经无事可做了。

lines.en: By vigorously masturbating in the blue glow of my computer’s light while wondering what has become of me and where I could be if I’d actually apply myself.
lines.zh: 在电脑幽蓝的光里卖力地自慰，同时琢磨着自己到底变成了什么样子，以及如果我真的肯用心，本可以走到哪一步。

lines.en: Maybe Wakana is onto something. Maybe I {i}should{/i} start writing again.
lines.zh: 也许 Wakana 说的有点道理。也许我确实{i}该{/i}重新开始写作了。

lines.en: I mean, it’s not like I haven’t {i}tried.{/i}
lines.zh: 我是说，我又不是没{i}试过{/i}。

lines.en: I {i}wanted{/i} to submit something for her stupid contest. Just...none of it felt right.
lines.zh: 我{i}想{/i}过给她那个蠢比赛投点东西。只是……全都不对劲。

lines.en: And it’s highly probable that nothing will {i}ever{/i} feel right again because I’m not the same person I was back then.
lines.zh: 而且极有可能{i}永远{/i}都不会再对劲了，因为我不再是那时候的那个人了。

lines.en: Or at least I think I’m not.
lines.zh: 至少我觉得我不是。

lines.en: I’m not really sure.
lines.zh: 我真的不确定。

lines.en: Looking back at the past is kind of difficult when the universe itself is constantly pulling the wool over your eyes.
lines.zh: 当宇宙本身一直在蒙着你的眼睛时，回望过去是件挺困难的事。

lines.en: scene utanightdate1
My efforts are more focused on the future for now.
lines.zh: 眼下我的精力更多是放在未来上。

lines.en: It’s easier to see.
lines.zh: 未来更容易看清。

lines.en: And there are things there I’ve yet to experience. Things I {i}want{/i} to experience because, like any other creature, I’m entirely and helplessly incomplete.
lines.zh: 而那里还有我没体验过的东西。我{i}想{/i}要去体验的东西——因为和任何生物一样，我彻底地、无助地残缺不全。

lines.en: But maybe there’s someone out there-
lines.zh: 但也许在某个地方存在某个人——

lines.en: Someone unexpected-
lines.zh: 某个出乎意料的人——

lines.en: Who can help complete me in a way no one else would ever anticipate.
lines.zh: 她能用一种谁都料想不到的方式，把我补全。

lines.en: : Well, if it isn’t Uta Ushibori.
lines.zh: : 哟，这不是 Uta Ushibori 吗。

lines.en: : What...what are you doing out here? It’s kind of late, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你……你在这儿干什么？天挺晚了吧？

lines.en: : I’m on my way back from your room.
lines.zh: : 我刚从你房间回来。

lines.en: : My room? But-
lines.zh: : 我房间？可是——

lines.en: scene utanightdate2
: Okay. Hold on one second, mister. I’m gonna need you to empty out your pockets so I can be sure you’re not going around and stealing more precious Uta-chan mementos to defile while Ami is asleep.
lines.zh: : 好了。等一下，先生。我需要你把口袋掏空，我得确认你没有又在外面偷走什么珍贵的 Uta 酱纪念品，好趁 Ami 睡着的时候拿去亵渎。

lines.en: : I promise I did not take any of your underwear this time.
lines.zh: : 我发誓这次我一件内衣都没拿。

lines.en: : I’m going to need a more specific promise, Sensei. Just saying you didn’t take any leaves open the possibility that I come home to a very sticky surprise in my panty drawer later.
lines.zh: : 我需要一个更具体的承诺，Sensei。光说“没拿”可留下了口子——说不定我回家会撞见内裤抽屉里黏糊糊的惊喜。

lines.en: : I didn’t do {i}anything{/i} inappropriate.
lines.zh: : 我没做{i}任何{/i}不规矩的事。

lines.en: : Besides breaking into my room, you mean.
lines.zh: : 除了闯进我房间之外，你是说。

lines.en: : Is it really “breaking in” if the door was unlocked?
lines.zh: : 如果门本来就没锁，那也算“闯”吗？

lines.en: scene utanightdate3
: Hah...no. I guess it’s not.
lines.zh: : 哈……不算。我想是不算。

lines.en: (She’s wrong. It is.)
lines.zh: （她错了。确实算。）

lines.en: scene utanightdate4

: Why go all the way over there, though? If you wanted to see me, you could have just called or something. I’ve already proven that I’m willing to drop my responsibilities for you. So it’s not like I’d say no.
lines.zh: : 可你为什么非要跑那么远过去？如果你想见我，打个电话什么的就行了啊。我已经证明过我愿意为你放下手头的事了。所以我总不至于拒绝吧。

lines.en: : I’ve found that the element of surprise often triggers more interesting events in the past, but I’ll keep that in mind going forward.
lines.zh: : 我发现出其不意往往能在过去触发更有趣的事，不过以后我会记住这点的。

lines.en: : Better question, though. What are {i}you{/i} doing out this late?
lines.zh: : 不过更好的问题是，{i}你{/i}这么晚在外头干什么？

lines.en: scene utanightdate5
: Coming back from the bath house. Me and Io wound up talking for a really long time, so she’s just going to sleep there when she’s done cleaning and {i}I{/i} am going to go home and be lonely.
lines.zh: : 从澡堂回来。{i}我{/i}和 Io 聊了很久，所以她打扫完就直接在那里睡了，而我要回家，然后一个人待着。

lines.en: : No. You’re going to hang out with me again.
lines.zh: : 不。你要再陪我一次。

lines.en: scene utanightdate6
: What? I am?
lines.zh: : 什么？我要？

lines.en: : Yes. I’ve decided.
lines.zh: : 对。我决定了。

lines.en: : It’s the park scene all over again. How come you keep deciding my schedule for me lately?
lines.zh: : 又来公园那一套。你怎么最近老是替我安排日程？

lines.en: : Because you’re letting me. Why would I stop doing a thing I like when I don’t get anything out of putting an end to it?
lines.zh: : 因为你让我安排啊。既然结束这件事我什么好处都捞不着，我为什么要停下一件我喜欢做的事？

lines.en: : I’m not saying I have a problem with it. We’ve just gone so long doing our back-and-forth act that the sudden switch to your assertive side is giving me butterflies.
lines.zh: : 我又没说我对此有意见。只是我们一来一回地演了那么久，你突然切换到强势的那一面，让我有点小鹿乱撞。

lines.en: : Platonic butterflies? Or butterflies that I’m supposed to ignore so your mind doesn’t start spiraling out of control like it did at the park?
lines.zh: : 柏拉图式的小鹿乱撞？还是那种我应该无视掉、免得你脑子又开始像在公园时那样失控的小鹿乱撞？

lines.en: scene utanightdate7
: Rest assured, there will be no Uta spiral tonight. There was enough of that at the bath house and I kinda hoped I’d be able to just put all of my feelings on hold until tomorrow morning.
lines.zh: : 放心吧，今晚不会有 Uta 式的胡思乱想。在澡堂的时候已经够多了，我还挺希望自己能把全部感情都搁到明天早上再说。

lines.en: : Should I just...leave you alone then?
lines.zh: : 那我是不是该……让你一个人待着？

lines.en: scene utanightdate8
: Honestly? You probably should.
lines.zh: : 说实话？你大概该。

lines.en: : Then-
lines.zh: : 那么——

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: scene utanightdate9
: I feel like I’ll really regret it if I...don’t take you up on your offer tonight...
lines.zh: : 我觉得如果今晚……不接受你的提议，我一定会后悔的……

lines.en: : Even if that offer was...more of a command than anything else.
lines.zh: : 哪怕那个提议……与其说是提议，不如说是命令。

lines.en: : You “feel like you’ll regret it?” Correct me if I’m wrong, but weren’t you trying not to {i}feel{/i} anything just a few seconds ago?
lines.zh: : 你“觉得会后悔”？如果我没记错的话，几秒钟前你不是还在努力什么都别去{i}感受{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, and then you had to go and ruin that by showing up when I least expected.
lines.zh: : 是啊，然后你非得在我最没防备的时候冒出来，把那一切给毁了。

lines.en: : I swear, you have either the worst or the best timing ever. I can’t figure out which one it is.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，你的时机把握要么是最烂的，要么是最好的。我分不清是哪一种。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure if I get what-
lines.zh: : 我不太确定我明不明白——

lines.en: scene utanightdate10
: You don’t have to be sure of anything, just...
lines.zh: : 你什么都不用确定，只要……

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Just take me somewhere no one will see us...
lines.zh: : 只要带我去一个没人会看见我们的地方……

lines.en: Of course, a million different things run through my head the moment she says that.
lines.zh: 当然，她这话一出口，一百万种念头立刻从我脑子里掠过。

lines.en: But, as desperate as I am for it to mean what I want it to mean, something about the tone of her voice and its mild tremolo tells me there’s more to it than that.
lines.zh: 可是，尽管我拼命希望它的意思就是我想要的意思，她语调里那一丝轻微的颤动告诉我，事情没那么简单。

lines.en: The thing is, those same qualities tell me that if I {i}do{/i} follow through...
lines.zh: 问题是，同样的这些特质又告诉我，如果我{i}真的{/i}顺着做下去……

lines.en: If I {i}do{/i} take her somewhere we can be alone...in the context that {i}I{/i} want...
lines.zh: 如果我{i}真的{/i}带她去一个我们能独处的地方……以{i}我{/i}想要的那种方式……

lines.en: She’d likely give in.
lines.zh: 她大概会就范。

lines.en: She might {i}want{/i} to give in. And making me grab the reins might just be her forcing me to take the first step so she doesn’t have to.
lines.zh: 她也许{i}想{/i}就范。而让我来掌缰，说不定只是她在逼我迈出第一步，好让她自己不用迈。

lines.en: But it might be a test as well.
lines.zh: 但这也可能是一场考验。

lines.en: It might be a trap.
lines.zh: 也可能是一个陷阱。

lines.en: If I were to take her hand and follow my heart down streets dyed red, I wonder what would cross her mind.
lines.zh: 如果我牵起她的手，顺着我的心走下那些被染成红色的街道，我不知道她脑子里会闪过什么。

lines.en: I wonder if, somewhere between the clouds of cigarette smoke in a neon-pink lobby and the incense that attempts to mask it, what her last words would be before we turn the key.
lines.zh: 我不知道，在霓虹粉大堂里缭绕的香烟云雾，和试图掩盖它的熏香之间，在我们转动钥匙之前，她最后会说什么。

lines.en: I wonder if she’d close her eyes when we kiss.
lines.zh: 我不知道我们接吻时她会不会闭上眼睛。

lines.en: If she’d wait for me to touch her first, or if she’d get too caught up in the moment and touch {i}me{/i} instead.
lines.zh: 她会等{i}我{/i}先碰她，还是会太投入其中，反而先来碰我。

lines.en: I wonder if she’d smile. Playfully bite my lip. Ask me to “mess her up” with her cheeks flushed red and her eyes halfway closed.
lines.zh: 我不知道她会不会笑。会不会顽皮地咬我的嘴唇。会不会涨红着脸、半眯着眼，要我“把她弄坏”。

lines.en: But among that garden of pleasant thoughts, there’s one {i}un{/i}pleasant one.
lines.zh: 但在那片美好的念头的花园里，有一朵{i}不{/i}那么美好的。

lines.en: It whispers to me that the flowers here are not done blooming yet- and that one wrong step could spell their end.
lines.zh: 它低声告诉我，这里的花还没开完——而走错一步，就可能意味着它们的终结。

lines.en: And so I am left with the choice to immerse myself in their unfinished beauty and risk destroying them...
lines.zh: 于是我就剩下这样的选择：沉浸在它们尚未完成的美丽里，冒着毁掉它们的风险……

lines.en: scene utanightdate11
Or to come back when they’re stronger and brighter.
lines.zh: 或者等它们更茁壮、更明艳的时候再来。

lines.en: When they can put up with being trampled for a little while.
lines.zh: 等到它们能忍受被踩踏一阵子的时候。

lines.en: It’s hard walking away from something so beautiful...so {i}entrancing.{/i} But I dilute the difficulty with the idea that I’m walking toward something {i}else{/i} instead.
lines.zh: 从如此美丽……如此{i}摄人心魄{/i}的东西旁边走开很难。但我用“我是走向{i}另一样{/i}东西”这个念头，把这份艰难稀释掉了。

lines.en: I’m trading one night for thousands. {i}Millions,{/i} maybe.
lines.zh: 我在用一夜交换成千上万夜。也许{i}几百万{/i}夜。

lines.en: Because taking her anywhere but here would do nothing but show her I’m exactly what she fears the most.
lines.zh: 因为带她去这儿以外的任何地方，都只会向她证明，我恰恰就是她最害怕的那种人。

lines.en: That I’m one more person who cares more about getting her into bed than waking up beside her.
lines.zh: 又一个只在乎把她弄上床、而不是醒来时躺在她身边的人。

lines.en: And you know what? Maybe I am.
lines.zh: 而且你知道吗？也许我确实是。

lines.en: But if believing I’m not can ease the ever-growing burden placed on her shoulders all those years ago, fuck it.
lines.zh: 可如果相信“我不是”，能稍稍减轻那些年前压在她肩上的、与日俱增的重负，那去他的。

lines.en: I can suffer another night of self-pleasure if it means that Uta can gain a little more confidence in the way she approaches me, because I {i}know{/i} she’s getting there.
lines.zh: 我可以再忍一夜的自我安慰，只要这能让 Uta 在靠近我这件事上多一点点自信，因为我{i}知道{/i}她正在往那儿走。

lines.en: And I {i}know{/i} how hard she’s trying {i}not{/i} to.
lines.zh: 我也{i}知道{/i}她有多努力地在克制自己{i}不去{/i}走。

lines.en: And I don’t want to give her an excuse to turn back around.
lines.zh: 而我不想给她一个掉头回去的借口。

lines.en: I want {i}her{/i} to lead {i}me{/i} down streets dyed red. I want {i}her{/i} to turn the key. To push me down onto some cheap, vibrating mattress.
lines.zh: 我想让{i}她{/i}牵着{i}我{/i}走下那些被染成红色的街道。我想让{i}她{/i}去转动钥匙。把我推倒在某张廉价、会震动的床垫上。

lines.en: : Have you been here before, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你以前来过这儿吗？

lines.en: And none of that will happen if I don’t let her bask in the light a little longer.
lines.zh: 而如果我不让她再在光里多沐浴一会儿，这些都不会发生。

lines.en: : Nope. In fact, I have absolutely no idea where we are. I just followed a sign that said “outlook.”
lines.zh: : 没有。事实上，我完全不知道我们在哪儿。我就是跟着一块写着“观景台”的牌子走过来的。

lines.en: : Well, we are certainly looking out.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们确实在往外看。

lines.en: : That we are, Uta. That we are.
lines.zh: : 是啊，Uta。是啊。

lines.en: : Do you like stuff like this, Sensei? Stargazing and nature and all that.
lines.zh: : 你喜欢这种东西吗，Sensei？看星星、大自然之类的。

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 谈不上喜欢，不喜欢。

lines.en: : Yeah, I didn’t think so.
lines.zh: : 是吧，我就知道。

lines.en: : Do you?
lines.zh: : 你呢？

lines.en: : Mmm...nature is fine. I like being outside. The stars and sky and stuff are kind of boring though.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大自然还行。我喜欢待在室外。不过星星啊天空啊什么的就有点无聊了。

lines.en: : It appears that I have failed you.
lines.zh: : 看来我让你失望了。

lines.en: : Hahah! No, you haven’t failed me. I asked you to take me somewhere we can be alone and that’s exactly what you did. This is nice.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！没有，你没让我失望。我让你带我去一个我们能独处的地方，你做到了。这样挺好的。

lines.en: : Plus, just because neither one of us is particularly into stargazing doesn’t mean that we can’t acknowledge that the sky is kinda pretty like this, right?
lines.zh: : 再说，就算我们俩都不怎么爱看星星，也不代表我们不能承认此刻的天空挺漂亮的，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess you’ve got a point there.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我想你说得有道理。

lines.en: : Tch. That was your cue to say, “But it’s not nearly as pretty as you, Uta. The stars aren’t even half as bright as your smile.” Or something like that. Way to go.
lines.zh: : 啧。这时候你该接一句：“可它远不如你漂亮，Uta。星星连你笑容一半亮都不到。”之类的。真是的。

lines.en: : I think we both know that you’d just laugh if I actually said something like that.
lines.zh: : 我想我们俩都清楚，我要是真说了那种话，你大概只会笑。

lines.en: : It depends on the mood, I think. There’s not really a better time than this to say corny stuff like that, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 那要看心情吧，我觉得。要说这种肉麻话，没有比现在更合适的时候了，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : It’s just you and me...in the middle of the night...down a winding path with no one else around...
lines.zh: : 只有你和我……在深夜里……走在这条弯弯绕绕、四下无人的小路上……

lines.en: : This sort of thing would be super romantic if I wasn’t just your rental-girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 如果我不只是你的“租来的女朋友”，这种场面绝对超浪漫。

lines.en: : Ah, yes. The girlfriend I rented for the large sum of zero yen.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。那个我花零日元巨款租来的女朋友。

lines.en: : Teacher discount. Valid until I graduate. Just make sure to leave me a good review.
lines.zh: : 教师折扣。有效期到我毕业。记得给我留个好评就行。

lines.en: : Seems I’m a repeat customer for basically everything you do, huh?
lines.zh: : 看来你做的每件事，我基本都是回头客了，是吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, but that’s not really impressive since I only do two things and one of them is just an inside joke.
lines.zh: 是啊，不过这也没什么了不起的，因为我总共就做两件事，其中一件还只是个内部梗。

lines.en: : Sorry, I guess that line wasn’t direct or flirty enough to hit your romantic criteria. What I really meant to say is “I’ll follow you to the end of the earth.”
lines.zh: : 抱歉，看来那句话不够直接或不够撩，没达到你的浪漫标准。我真正想说的是“我会跟你到天涯海角”。

lines.en: : Where does the earth even end?
lines.zh: : 天涯海角到底在哪儿啊？

lines.en: : Okay, I guess I’m just not good at this. Which, to be fair, is exactly what both of us expected.
lines.zh: : 好吧，看来我确实不擅长这个。不过平心而论，这本来就在我们俩的预料之中。

lines.en: : Heheh...no, that one was fine. I’m just being a brat.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……不，那句挺好的。我只是在耍性子。

lines.en: : Yeah, what else is new?
lines.zh: : 是啊，有什么新鲜的吗？

lines.en: : Soooo....
lines.zh: : 那那那……
: 所以……

lines.en: : Stars. Am I right?
lines.zh: : 星星。我说得对吧？

lines.en: : Stars, indeed. I have no idea what Maya sees in them.
lines.zh: : 星星，确实。我真搞不懂 Maya 到底看中它们什么。

lines.en: : Ah! No talking about other girls on a secret rendezvous. That’s against the rules.
lines.zh: : 啊！秘密幽会的时候不许提别的女孩。这是规矩。

lines.en: : Well, how else am I going to continue a conversation on a topic I know nothing about? You had a million options for something else to choose and you went right back to a thing we’re both not interested in.
lines.zh: : 那不然你让我怎么把一个我完全不懂的话题聊下去？你明明有上百万个别的话题可以选，却偏偏绕回一个我们俩都不感兴趣的东西。

lines.en: : There’s gotta be something! Like...
lines.zh: : 总该有什么的！比如……

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Like...what’s your favorite constellation?
lines.zh: : 比如……你最喜欢的星座是什么？

lines.en: : Probably...
lines.zh: : 大概是……

lines.en: : The Summer Triangle.
lines.zh: : 夏季大三角。

lines.en: : Ooooh. Romantic.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦。好浪漫。

lines.en: : It’s the only one I know anything about.
lines.zh: : 那是我唯一了解一点的星座。

lines.en: : Altair and Vega, right? I remember that story from some camp thingy I went to when I was little. It’s actually pretty sad when you really think about it, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是 Altair 和 Vega 吧？我小时候去参加某个露营活动的时候听过那个故事。仔细想想其实挺伤感的，不是吗？

lines.en: : The Altair and Vega story? Or the fact that you used to go camping?
lines.zh: : Altair 和 Vega 的故事？还是说你去露营这件事？

lines.en: : Hey! There’s nothing wrong with camping. Like I said, nature is fine. Besides, it was less of an actual “camping” thing and more of just a way for kids to meet and play with each other and stuff.
lines.zh: : 嘿！露营有什么不好的。我说了，大自然挺好的。再说了，那也算不上真正的“露营”，更像是让小孩们聚在一起互相玩耍之类的。

lines.en: : The sky was really nice in Nara, though. It felt...bigger.
lines.zh: : 不过奈良的天空真的很美。感觉……更大。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, Nara didn’t have the same level of light pollution we have here. The urban district’s effect probably covers all of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 是啊，奈良没有我们这儿这么严重的光污染。市区的影响大概把整个 Kumon-mi 都盖住了。

lines.en: : You think so? I think the sky looks pretty clear some nights.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我觉得有些晚上天空看起来挺清澈的啊。

lines.en: : It doesn’t happen all the time, but...tonight for example. This is beautiful.
lines.zh: : 不是每次都这样，不过……比如今晚。这就很美。

lines.en: : It’s just not Nara.
lines.zh: : 只是不是奈良。

lines.en: : You really miss it there, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真的很想念那里，对吧？

lines.en: scene utanightdate12
: Sometimes, yeah.
lines.zh: : 有时候吧，嗯。

lines.en: : I like being close to the city. But every once in a while, there’s a night like tonight where I think it’d be nice to be somewhere a little more peaceful.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢离城市近一点。但偶尔也会有像今晚这样的夜晚，让我觉得待在一个更安静点的地方会不错。

lines.en: : It’s harder to relax over here, you know? There’s always something going on. Especially in the dorms since there are friggin’ twenty of us.
lines.zh: : 在这儿更难放松下来，你知道吗？总是有事情在发生。尤其是宿舍，毕竟我们他妈的有二十个人。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I just miss my old futon. And the way my nightlight lit up the shoji whenever I went to sleep. And the fifteen deer who lived in our living room.
lines.zh: 有时候，我就是会想念我那床旧被褥。想念我睡觉时小夜灯照在纸拉门上的样子。还有住在我们客厅里的那十五只鹿。

lines.en: : I feel like that last one is an exaggeration even by Nara standards.
lines.zh: : 我觉得最后那条就算按奈良的标准也算夸张了。

lines.en: : What would you know? You’ve never been there.
lines.zh: : 你懂什么？你又没去过。

lines.en: : I’ve never had a reason to go.
lines.zh: : 我一直没有理由去。

lines.en: scene utanightdate13
: Do you want one?
lines.zh: : 你想来一次吗？

lines.en: : I have no interest in meeting your parents, Uta.
lines.zh: : 我可没兴趣见你父母，Uta。

lines.en: : We don’t have to go when they’re around. It can be just you and me.
lines.zh: : 不一定要在他们的时候去。就你和我也可以。

lines.en: : Is this about that “Uta-sanctioned tour” or whatever it was you mentioned last time we talked about this?
lines.zh: : 这是关于你上次提到的那个“Uta 认证导览”之类的东西吗？

lines.en: : Mmm...yes and no.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是也不是。

lines.en: : There would obviously still be a tour. Just my reasons for inviting you are a little different from wanting to show you more about me now.
lines.zh: : 导览当然还是会有的。只是我邀请你的理由，和当初想让你多了解我一点，已经有点不一样了。

lines.en: : Different how?
lines.zh: : 哪里不一样？

lines.en: scene utanightdate14
: I’d tell you, but I’d have to kill you.
lines.zh: : 我可以告诉你，但我得杀了你灭口。

lines.en: : Then kill me. I want to know.
lines.zh: : 那就杀了我。我想知道。

lines.en: : Are you sure? If you die, you’ll never get to meet the council of living room deer and trade them a piece of oak bark in exchange for eternal life.
lines.zh: : 你确定？你要是死了，就永远见不到客厅鹿议会，也永远没法用一块橡树皮跟它们换来永生了。

lines.en: : Nara sure has some strange customs.
lines.zh: : 奈良的风俗可真够奇怪的。

lines.en: : If only Grandpa had some oak bark...
lines.zh: : 要是爷爷有块橡树皮就好了……

lines.en: : And here we go again.
lines.zh: : 又来了。

lines.en: scene utanightdate15
: Hmhmhm...ahahah! Hahahah!
lines.zh: : 哼哼哼……哈哈哈！哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : I’m glad that {i}you’re{/i} at least getting a laugh at how uncomfortable you make everyone whenever you bring your grandfather up.
lines.zh: : 至少{i}你{/i}还能笑得出来——每次你提起你爷爷，都能把周围所有人弄得有多不自在。

lines.en: : It’s not that! It’s not that...
lines.zh: : 不是那样！不是那样的……

lines.en: scene utanightdate16
: I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: scene utanightdate17
: Uta?
lines.zh: : Uta？

lines.en: : I’m really stupid, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我真的很蠢，Sensei。

lines.en: : I know that already.
lines.zh: : 我早就知道了。

lines.en: scene utanightdate18
: You only know half of it and it’s not the half I’m talking about.
lines.zh: : 你只知道一半，而且不是我要说的那一半。

lines.en: : Well, then tell me the half you’re talking about or I’m just going to keep accidentally insulting you.
lines.zh: : 那就把你说的那一半告诉我，不然我只会继续不小心得罪你。

lines.en: : Even if you have to kill me afterward. It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 就算说完之后你得杀了我。没关系。

lines.en: scene utanightdate17
: Hahah...fuck.
lines.zh: : 哈哈……操。

lines.en: : Fuck fuck fuck fuck fuck.
lines.zh: : 操操操操操。

lines.en: : I agree. Good talk.
lines.zh: : 我同意。聊得不错。

lines.en: scene utanightdate19
: Sensei, I...
lines.zh: : Sensei，我……

lines.en: : You...
scene utanightdate20
: Wow. You’re really bad at this.
lines.zh: : 哇。你真是不擅长这个。

lines.en: scene utanightdate21
: Shut up! I want to do {i}this{/i} more often! That’s what I wanted to say!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！我想多来几次{i}这种事{/i}！我就是想说这个！

lines.en: : Is that {i}all{/i} you wanted to say?
lines.zh: : 你就{i}只{/i}想说这个吗？

lines.en: : No! But just that was hard and it’s all I {i}can{/i} say right now!
lines.zh: : 不是！可光是这句就已经很难了，而且我现在只{i}能{/i}说出这些！

lines.en: : Uta-
lines.zh: : Uta——

lines.en: : No, listen! I...
lines.zh: : 不，你听我说！我……

lines.en: : You’re...
scene utanightdate22
: Mngh...
: Like I said earlier...me and Io talked about a lot of stuff tonight....And you were one of the things we talked about.
lines.zh: : 就像我刚才说的……今晚我和 Io 聊了很多……而你就是我们聊到的事情之一。

lines.en: : I still don’t...I don’t fully get what it would be like for all three of us to be a {i}thing{/i} and...that’s not something I’m really...uh...
lines.zh: : 我还是……我不太明白我们三个{i}在一起{/i}会是什么样子，而且……那也不是我真正……呃……

lines.en: : Anyway, there was...there was something she said to me about how...how she sees the two of {i}us.{/i} And how she thinks we’d...um...
lines.zh: : 总之，她说过一些……关于她怎么看我们俩的话。还有她觉得{i}我们{/i}会……嗯……

lines.en: : She thinks we’re a good match, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: : 她觉得我们很般配，对吧？

lines.en: scene utanightdate23
: Sensei, when I’m with you...it’s like...
lines.zh: : Sensei，和你在一起的时候……感觉就像……

lines.en: : It’s like there’s a {i}third{/i} Uta.
lines.zh: : 就像有{i}第三{/i}个 Uta。

lines.en: : It’s not just Uta and Uta-chan anymore, there’s like...a broken one too. Or a...{i}more{/i} broken one, I guess.
lines.zh: : 不再只是 Uta 和 Uta 酱了，好像还多了……一个坏掉的。或者……{i}更{/i}坏的那个，我猜。

lines.en: : And all she does is wonder what you’re thinking of her and whether or not she’s saying the right stuff or...
lines.zh: : 而她所做的，就只是揣测你对她是什么想法、她有没有说对话，或者……

lines.en: : Or just...trying to make you laugh. Or smile...Or {i}like{/i} her...and I don’t know how to make it stop.
lines.zh: 或者只是……想逗你笑。想让你微笑……想让你{i}喜欢{/i}她……而我根本不知道怎么让它停下来。

lines.en: : Do you {i}want{/i} it to stop?
lines.zh: : 你{i}想{/i}让它停下来吗？

lines.en: : {i}No.{/i} Because having all of those things going crazy inside of my head stops me from thinking about all the stuff I hate about myself.
lines.zh: : {i}不想{/i}。因为脑子里这些东西闹得鸡飞狗跳，我就不会去想所有我讨厌自己的地方。

lines.en: : But at the same time, I’m worried {i}you’re{/i} going to hate me. And Io says you won’t, but-
lines.zh: : 可与此同时，我又担心{i}你{/i}会讨厌我。Io 说你不会，但是——

lines.en: : Io’s right. I won’t.
lines.zh: : Io 说得对。我不会。

lines.en: : But what if you change your mind?
lines.zh: : 可要是你改主意了呢？

lines.en: : My...{i}situation...{/i}
: It wasn’t just one picture...and it wasn’t just one {i}guy{/i} either. I don’t think I made that...clear last time.
lines.zh: : 不只是一张照片……也不只是一个{i}男人{/i}。我想上次我没说……清楚。

lines.en: scene utanightdate24
: It was the one guy who took things too far, yeah...but...there were others {i}before{/i} him. And they could still {i}have{/i} pictures of me that I don’t even {i}know{/i} about.
lines.zh: : 是有那么一个做得太过的男人，没错……可是……在他{i}之前{/i}还有别人。而且他们可能到现在{i}还留着{/i}我甚至根本不{i}知道{/i}的照片。

lines.en: : You don’t have to-
lines.zh: : 你不用——

lines.en: scene utanightdate25

: No, I {i}do{/i} have to tell you this because I don’t want you to waste your time on someone who isn’t worth it! And I don’t want to get my hopes up just to have you leave when you realize what I am!
lines.zh: : 不，我{i}必须{/i}告诉你这些，因为我不想你把时间浪费在一个不值得的人身上！我也不想在刚燃起希望之后，等你认清我是什么东西就一走了之！

lines.en: : You’re {i}not{/i} what you think you are.
lines.zh: : 你{i}不是{/i}你以为的那种人。

lines.en: : No, I’m not what {i}you{/i} think I am!
lines.zh: : 不，我不是{i}你{/i}以为的那种人！

lines.en: : I’m not just some girl who made {i}one{/i} stupid decision when she was little and wound up getting screwed over! I made a million of them! And I {i}liked{/i} it!
lines.zh: : 我不是那个小时候犯了{i}一个{/i}蠢决定就被坑了的普通女孩！我犯了一百万个！而且我{i}乐在其中{/i}！

lines.en: : And...and I’d probably {i}still{/i} like it if it never came back and bit me in the ass! Like, who even knows what I’d be doing now if that never happened?!
lines.zh: 而且……而且如果它从来没有回过头来咬我的屁股，我大概到现在{i}还会{/i}乐在其中！就是说，如果那事从来没发生，谁知道我现在会在干什么？！

lines.en: : But it did happen. And it changed you.
lines.zh: : 可它确实发生了。而且它改变了你。

lines.en: scene utanightdate26

: Except it {i}didn’t{/i} change me. The only thing it changed is who I’m in contact with and how reluctant I am to let anyone in. I’m still the same filthy pervert I was back then, I just keep it to myself now.
lines.zh: : 可它{i}没有{/i}改变我。它唯一改变的，是我和谁来往，以及我有多不情愿让别人走进来。我骨子里还是当年那个肮脏的变态，只是现在不外露了。

lines.en: : So...if I were to have taken you back to a love hotel tonight instead of here, what do you think would have happened?
lines.zh: : 那么……如果今晚我带你去的是情人酒店而不是这儿，你觉得会发生什么？

lines.en: scene utanightdate27
: I think...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……

lines.en: : I think I probably would have made another bad decision...
lines.zh: : 我觉得我大概又会犯一个错误……

lines.en: : Would you have liked that more than {i}this?{/i}
lines.zh: : 比起{i}这样{/i}，你会更喜欢那个吗？

lines.en: scene utanightdate28
: Would you have preferred we did that? Or are you happy we came here instead?
lines.zh: : 你更希望我们那么做吗？还是说你很高兴我们来了这儿？

lines.en: : To be honest, I wanted to take you to a hotel. It was the first thing I thought of.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我本来是想带你去酒店的。那是我第一个念头。

lines.en: : Then...why would you...
lines.zh: : 那……你为什么……

lines.en: : To show you that there’s more to you than just that — which is something I’m pretty sure you’re aware of, yet you keep bringing your past to the forefront because, like you said-
lines.zh: : 为了向你证明，你身上不只有那一面——这一点我敢说你心里清楚，可你还是不停地把过去摆到最前面，因为就像你说的——

lines.en: : I’m reluctant to let anyone in...
lines.zh: : 我不情愿让别人走进来……

lines.en: : Bingo.
lines.zh: : 答对了。

lines.en: scene utanightdate29
: I’m really happy we came here instead...
lines.zh: : 我真的很高兴我们来了这儿……

lines.en: : I knew you would be. That’s why I did it.
lines.zh: : 我就知道你会。所以我才这么做。

lines.en: : Ugh...damn it, Io. How come you’re always so wrong when it comes to yourself, but you hit all the nails with {i}my{/i} name on them right on the head?
lines.zh: : 呃……可恶，Io。为什么一碰到你自己的事你就总是错得离谱，可每一根写着{i}我{/i}名字的钉子你都能敲得正中靶心？

lines.en: : She {i}is{/i} a builder after all.
lines.zh: : 她{i}毕竟是{/i}个建筑工人嘛。

lines.en: : Does my past really not gross you out, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我的过去真的不让你反感吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Did I not...make it clear enough just how young I was when all of this happened?
lines.zh: : 我是不是……没说清楚这一切发生的时候我有多小？

lines.en: : I’m not concerned about the past. I’m more focused on spending time with the two- or apparently {i}three{/i} Utas I have here right now.
lines.zh: : 我不在意过去。我更专注于和我此刻拥有的两个——或者说显然{i}三个{/i} Uta 待在一起。

lines.en: : And if one of those Utas starts to want more from you than you’re able to give...what then?
lines.zh: : 那如果其中一个 Uta 开始想从你这儿要的比你能给的更多……那怎么办？

lines.en: : I’ll just take something from {i}her{/i} to make up for it.
lines.zh: : 我就从{i}她{/i}身上拿点东西来补。

lines.en: : And if {i}she{/i} doesn’t have anything to give?
lines.zh: : 那如果{i}她{/i}什么都给不了呢？

lines.en: : Then she’s probably just not looking hard enough.
lines.zh: : 那她大概只是找得还不够努力。

lines.en: : Are you regretting your choice to hang out with me tonight yet?
lines.zh: : 你开始后悔今晚答应陪我了吗？

lines.en: scene utanightdate30
: I would never.
lines.zh: : 我永远不会。

lines.en: : Are you regretting inviting me?
lines.zh: : 你后悔邀请我了吗？

lines.en: : Nope. All good here.
lines.zh: : 没有。这边一切良好。

lines.en: : That’s reassuring.
lines.zh: : 那我就放心了。

lines.en: : Do it more often.
lines.zh: : 多来几次。

lines.en: : Do what? Invite you out?
lines.zh: : 多来几次什么？约你出来？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Spend all of your free time on me from now on.
lines.zh: : 从现在起，把你所有的空闲时间都花在我身上。

lines.en: : Every single second of it.
lines.zh: : 每一秒。

lines.en: : Is my money not enough?
lines.zh: : 我的钱不够吗？

lines.en: : You can keep your money. What I really want is {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 钱你留着。我真正想要的是{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Can I take that as an official confession?
lines.zh: : 这能当作正式的表白吗？

lines.en: scene black
: Not yet.
lines.zh: : 还不行。

lines.en: : Well, how long am I going to have to wait for one? Because all signs within a ten mile radius point to you having feelings for me.
lines.zh: : 那我得等多久？因为方圆十英里内的所有迹象都指向你对我有感情。

lines.en: : Feelings? What are those? I thought I said I was done with them tonight.
lines.zh: : 感情？那是什么？我记得我说过今晚不碰感情了吧。

lines.en: : That was like three hours and three hundred feelings ago.
lines.zh: : 那是三个小时、三百份感情之前的事了。

lines.en: : Three hours? There’s no way it’s been- oh my God, it’s been three hours.
lines.zh: : 三个小时？不可能已经——天哪，真的已经三个小时了。

lines.en: : Do you need to start heading back?
lines.zh: : 你需要开始往回走了吗？

lines.en: else:
: Am I going to get in trouble for sleeping in class tomorrow?
lines.zh: : 我明天上课睡觉会被罚吗？

lines.en: : Do you ever?
lines.zh: : 你哪次被罚过？

lines.en: : Good point.
lines.zh: : 说得对。

lines.en: : Another hour wouldn’t hurt...
lines.zh: : 再来一个小时也无妨……

lines.en: One hour becomes two.
lines.zh: 一个小时变成两个。

lines.en: Then two becomes three.
lines.zh: 然后两个变成三个。

lines.en: And before I know it, my walk back home is illuminated by the glow of the rising sun.
lines.zh: 而等我回过神来，我走回家的路已经被初升的太阳照亮了。

lines.en: I met another match tonight.
lines.zh: 今晚我又遇到了一个对手。

lines.en: I hope I’ll see her again tomorrow.
lines.zh: 希望明天还能再见到她。

lines.en: $ utadorm40p2 = True
$ uta_love += 5
{i}Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]!{/i}
